Hi Marissa 6

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear MAP. A couple quick notes from my side after syncing with procurement/legal:

- Target close on 2026-10-22 looks reasonable from the commercial team perspective.
- Procurement signature by 2026-10-29 is tight but doable if we get the security artifacts and the contract by 10/12.
- Sonia (procurement) will need a PO timeline; she asked whether Redwood can accept a 30-day PO after signature.
- Martin (legal) flagged two clauses we're likely to redline: indemnity limits and data retention language. He'll share comments by 10/12.

Can your legal/SE team commit to turning around contract updates within 3 business days of receiving our redlines? Also, does Redwood have SOC2 Type II evidence and a short security one-pager we can hand to procurement?
